name: 45840-longprefill-qwen3moe30b-mrv2-4gpu
hardware: 4x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 of ONE a3 node (--gres=gpu:4), sm90, NVLink between the cards.
parallelism: TP=4 with expert parallelism enabled, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine, one node.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=128, unbounded arrival rate. Bounded at 768 requests with a 900 s safety cap, of which 256 are warmup (`warmup: {value: 256, mode: requests}`), leaving about 512 measured. No cooldown. Seed static 45840.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt EXACTLY 8192 tokens (min = max = 8192) and output EXACTLY 256 (min = max = 256), greedy (temperature 0.0), with ignore_eos set so every request emits all 256 tokens. `request_format: plain` -- the prompt goes to the engine as raw text with no chat template around it.
purpose: A document analysis assistant summarizing long reports for 128 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit c88d3d4775c41793543e97f1609d3161a5689905
#   (`git describe --tags` = v0.23.1rc0-218-gc88d3d477 -- a commit, not a release).
#
# `max-num-batched-tokens` is written out because `vllm serve` and an in-process launch resolve
# DIFFERENT defaults from the same table at this commit (8192 vs 16384); 8192 is the declared
# value. `gpu-memory-utilization` and `enable-prefix-caching` are this commit's own defaults,
# pinned so a change of default cannot move them between runs. Nothing here is tuned.
#
# `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER` cannot live in this file -- it is read while the config object is
# constructed, so it is not expressible as an engine argument. See configs/tuned.yaml.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 4
enable-expert-parallel: true
max-num-seqs: 128
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
